comments:
a35d6e9b: ;
 ;This routine queues a task to run a specified program at a later time.
 ;It saves program variables and checks necessary parameters before
 ;queuing the task.
09eabd43: ;Set the queuing date/time to the current date/time.
26f0a94e: ;If the terminal type is not defined but IO is set to NULL, set ZTIO to NULL.
7aa97e54: ;If a task description is not defined, set it to the program name or 'IRT UNKNOWN OPTION' if no program is defined.
db18968e: ;If the routine to be run is not defined, set it to the program name if defined, else set it to nothing. If no program name, go to CLOSE. Otherwise set ZTRTN to run the DQ^DGJUTQ routine.
5aebcd11: ;Save the variables passed in DGVAR or VAR or '*' if neither is defined by calling the SAVE^DIO routine.
f45716b1: ;If DGPGM is defined but not saved in ZTSAVE, set ZTSAVE("DGPGM") to null.
90cd8c4c: Loads the saved routine and displays a message indicating whether the request was queued or canceled.
bd268caf: Returns from the routine.
9bc2f92b: Prompts the user to specify a device for output or queue. If a device is selected, sends output to that device. If a queue is selected, queues the output.
ac410a16: Uses the selected device or queue for output.
a0d3bc55: Saves variables specified in DGZTSAVE into the ZTSAVE array. Handles cases where the variable name ends with an open parenthesis.
07e2a048: Returns from the routine.
55f00dfb: ;Replace all occurrences of '#' in DGZTSAVE with '('
85a7248c: ;Return from the routine after replacing all occurrences
3fa501a9: Cleanup routine; close device if not running in a background task.
ea8a0bbc: Cleanup routine; kill all task-related nodes.
d72f5157: Cleanup routine; allow EXIT from the main code.
3468ebe2: If program variable is defined, execute that routine; otherwise execute 'CLOSE' routine.
947574fb: Kill the task from the system and close device.
261a0bd0: Allow EXIT from subroutine.

587a47d3:  ;Compute and store the task due time (time for scheduled job).
 ;Extract the due time and convert to external format.
 ;Due time is stored as HHMMSSxxyyzz where:
 ; HH = hours
 ; MM = minutes
 ; SS = seconds
 ; xx = hundredths of seconds
 ; yy = offset in minutes from GMT
 ; zz = 1 if daylight savings time, 0 if not
3e99cf5c: Allow EXIT from subroutine.
